body.statement: For a binary instrument, binary outcome, and exactly three well-defining exposure levels, Gabriel, Sachs, and Sjolander equations (3)--(4) give the sharp contrast endpoints as the maximum of ten affine lower expressions and the minimum of ten affine upper expressions: the eight classical expressions plus two expressions involving the third exposure level on each side.

attestation.note: Verified directly against the arXiv source text displaying ten lower and ten upper expressions for three well-defining exposure levels.

body.justification: This source-level result supports the exact ten-term ternary comparator equality.
body.gap: The present proof supplies the term-by-term relabeling from the arbitrary-support envelope to the published ternary formulas.
